Weekend speech rbnz

Speaker: Adrian Orr

Economic outlook

Real GDP is projected to grow by 1.2% in 2026 and by 1.5% in 2027.

Inflation

Inflation is projected to average 3.4% in 2026.

Labour market

The unemployment rate is projected to average 5.0% in 2026.

Financial stability

Financial conditions remained tight and monetary policy transmission continued to function smoothly.

Monetary policy

The Monetary Policy Committee decided to hold the OCR.

The Committee will keep the OCR restrictive for as long as necessary.

Risks

Risks to inflation were broadly balanced.
